key_points: ICANN approval of .web clears a multi-year dispute; phased rollout with first key phase Dec. 10 is a genuine new-TLD catalyst beyond .com/.net
Near-term financial contribution likely small relative to the .com/.net base; watch pricing, registry economics and any trademark/channel conflict
Several 'overvalued / 43% above fair value' pieces are formulaic valuation commentary, not thesis-changing
13F/institutional buying and 'invested $1000' items are stale or generic noise
Dec. 10 date gives a defined event window; negative surprise risk is launch delays or weak registrations
